name: POST /api/requests/:requestId/draft-message - AI suggestion for the client message
description: Projects:write, draft requests only. The platform model (route request_wording) drafts the client-facing message from the request's items, which reach the model as fenced data blocks; the answer must pass the route's output checks (plain prose up to 1,500 characters, no links or addresses), with one retry, else 502 AI_OUTPUT_REJECTED. The suggestion is returned, NOT saved: the consultant edits it, saves the draft (PATCH) and approves. Needs a running model (local Ollama in development; about 25 s on qwen2.5:3b-instruct). Audited (client_request.message_drafted). Covers: the tool drafts the request text and nothing is sent until the consultant edits and approves it.

errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Needs a model answer that fails the output checks twice; a run cannot steer the model into that. The checks are covered by the prompt-injection CI suite.
